abilities.name: Subdue and Interrogate
abilities.text: You add +Rank bonus dice to all Intimidation and Insight tests during an interrogation. In addition, when you make an attack with an Agonizing weapon and your target exceeds their Max Wounds as a result, you may choose for them to become unconscious (unable to take further action, unaware of their surroundings) rather than dying.

name: Crimson Hunter Aspect Warrior

abilities.name: Skyhunter
abilities.text: When you make a shooting attack against another FLYER, add +Rank bonus dice to your attack.

note: XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 180. The printed 160 is the ratings alone, without the Archetype Ability's 20.

name: Cthonian Beserk
note: "Beserk" as printed (heading, stat block and p.72 table).

abilities.name: Hardened Augmetics
abilities.text: Your Resilience is increased by +Rank, but you may not wear any armour. In addition, when you roll Determination, you may re-roll any dice which roll 1.

abilities.name: Undercover Agent
abilities.text: You gain +Rank bonus dice on all Deception tests make to disguise yourself or present yourself as someone else. In addition, you may spend an Exalted Icon from a Deception test to grant yourself the use of a Keyword which you don’t normally possess. This keyword must relate to your current disguise or alias.

wargear.name: sets of clothing for use in disguises

name: Devastator Space Marine
note: No suggested attributes or skills printed.

abilities.name: Unrelenting Devastation
abilities.text: When you sacrifice your Move to Brace a Heavy weapon, you may re-roll +Rank dice on attacks with that weapon, and +Rank ED to that weapon’s damage.

wargear.name: missile launcher with 6 frag and 6 krak missiles

abilities.name: Close Protection
abilities.text: When an enemy makes an attack against an ally within 5m of you, then as a Reflexive Action, you may increase that ally’s Defence and Resilience by +Rank against that attack.

name: Ethereal
note: The page also says: "Ethereals may purchase Invocations of the Ethereals, found later in this manuscript." XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 180.

abilities.name: Voice of the Tau'va
abilities.text: You gain +Rank bonus dice whenever you make a social Skill Test against a T’AU EMPIRE character. This increases to +Double Rank if the character’s species is Shas T’au, Fio T’au, Por T’au, or Kor T’au.

abilities.name: Gun-Crazy Show-Off
abilities.text: If you roll a 6 on your Wrath die when making a ranged attack, you may spend a reload to immediately make a second shooting attack with that weapon at the nearest target.

name: Havoc
note: No suggested attributes or skills printed.

abilities.name: Addicted to Destruction
abilities.text:
When you roll a 6 on your Wrath die when making a ranged attack, you may forego the critical hit and spend a reload in order to make a second ranged attack with that weapon. This second attack cannot produce further attacks.

In addition, you gain 1d3x3 Corruption when you select this Archetype.

wargear.name: missile launcher with 6 frag and 6 krak missiles

name: Legionary
note: No suggested attributes or skills printed.

abilities.name: Master of Slaughter
abilities.text:
When you inflict a critical hit, you count as having spent 1 Glory to improve the effect. You may still spend additional Glory to improve the effect further.

In addition, you gain 1d3x3 Corruption when you select this Archetype.

name: Null-Maiden
note: SPECIES printed "Pariah": the Human template (p.12, option group pariah-and-perpetual), whose 30 XP is included in Pariah archetype costs. "Psyk-out Grenades" printed with no count. The printed 110 is ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 exactly, so it doesn't include the template's 30 either. XP as printed plus the Pariah template's 30 XP, which p.12 says every Pariah archetype includes (GM ruling, docs/rules-flow.md §11.37).

abilities.name: Daughter of the Abyss
abilities.text: You add +Rank ED to all attacks you make against creatures with the PSYKER or DAEMON keyword.

name: Raptor
note: No suggested attributes or skills printed. Unlike Havoc, Legionary and the Tier 4 Chaos archetypes, the ability prints no Corruption gain.

abilities.name: Cruel Hunters
abilities.text: Enemies within 15 metres of you add your Rank to the DN of any Resolve tests they are required to make.

name: Shining Spear Aspect Warrior
note: No suggested talents printed.

abilities.name: Ride the Wind
abilities.text: You may reroll Double Rank dice on any Pilot test you make when operating an Aeldari Jetbike and increase the jetbike’s Defence by +Rank.

name: Primaris Apothecary
note: The Primaris block of "Space Marine Apothecary (Adeptus Astartes, Tier 3/Tier 4)". "Mar X Tacticus Power Armour" as printed (Mk X). No suggested talents printed for this block. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 264. The page's Tier 3 Adeptus Astartes block prints 276.

abilities.name: Guard Thy Brethren
abilities.text: Whenever you succeed at a Medicae test upon a Dying ally with the ADEPTUS ASTARTES keyword, gain 1 Wrath. In addition, you gain +Rank to Resolve and Determination while you can see or hear one or more Dying Adeptus Astartes allies.

abilities.name: Crime Scene Investigation
abilities.text: You have seen enough crime scenes that you can quickly identify common patterns. When you shift one or more Exalted Icons on an Investigation test, you count as having shifted +Rank additional Exalted Icons (this doesn’t affect whether you pass or fail, just the number of extra benefits you get from shifting).

name: Weirdboy
note: The stat block is headed "FLASH GIT" (print error; the page heading is Weirdboy). No Influence printed. The suggested talents are WAAAGH! psychic powers. The WAAAGH! discipline is the Species' one Discipline of choice (Disciplines Known, Core p.257), so `onlyDisciplines` keeps it to that, Minor powers and Smite (docs/rules-flow.md §11.62, GitHub issue #8).

abilities.name: The Power of the WAAAGH!
abilities.text: You are a Psyker; you know the Smite psychic power. You know the WAAAGH discipline, and one power from that Discipline. When using psychic powers, you do not choose a Power Level; rather, you gain one additional Wrath die for every five Orks within 20 metres of you. You must roll these Wrath dice. Each 1 rolled on a Wrath die when using a Psychic Power inflicts one Mortal Wound on you instead of a roll on the Perils of the Warp table, and if you exceed your Max Wounds from this, you explode, dying instantly and inflicting 1d3+Tier Mortal Wounds on all Orks within 20 metres.

name: Zephyrim
note: Suggested talent not in the catalogue: Brutal (p. 130), as printed (Core p.130 has Brutalist). Wargear printed "a copy of the Rule of the Sororitas".

abilities.name: Angelic
abilities.text: You and any allies within 15 metres gain +Double Rank bonus dice to Corruption Tests and Resolve Tests. You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to any Test to resist the effects of a Psychic Power.

name: Chaos Sorcerer
note: KEYWORDS also print: "You may not select the KHORNE keyword." The suggested talents are psychic powers. The Universal Psyker Abilities come with the PSYKER keyword (Core p.375); the "one other Psychic Discipline of your choice" is the Species' default choice (Disciplines Known, Core p.257), so it isn't granted here.

abilities.name: Sorcery
abilities.text:
You are a psyker; you have all the Universal psyker abilities, you know the Smite psychic power. You know the Dark Hereticus discipline, and receive one power from that Discipline, and you may select one other Psychic Discipline of your choice to learn powers from.

In addition, you gain 1d3x4 Corruption when you select this Archetype.

name: Dark Apostle
note: Wargear printed "3 frag and krak grenades". The page also says: "Dark Apostles may purchase Prayers to the Dark Gods, found later in this manuscript."

abilities.name: Accursed Demagogue
abilities.text:
You, and all allies with the CHAOS keyword within 15+Rank metres add +Rank to Resolve. This increases to +Double Rank if they share your [MARK OF CHAOS] or [LEGION] keyword.

In addition, you gain 1d3x4 Corruption when you select this Archetype.

name: Genetor
note: Suggested talent printed "The Rite of Pure Thought (p. 139)". "Availability N (Rarity)" is read as a Value of N or less and that Rarity or lower (the wargear filters).

abilities.name: Magos Biologis
abilities.text: You add +Rank bonus dice to any Medicae test you attempt and take only half as long to perform a Medicae test. In addition, your bioengineered and genetic augmentations increase your Max Wounds and Max Shock by +Rank.

name: Grey Knight Space Marine
note: No suggested attributes or skills printed. Astral Aim and Hammerhand, under SUGGESTED TALENTS, are Sanctic psychic powers. The page says Grey Knights must select the GREY KNIGHTS chapter option (p.27) and benefit from the ORDO MALLEUS keyword (Core p.64). The Sanctic discipline is the Species' one Discipline of choice (Disciplines Known, Core p.257), so `onlyDisciplines` keeps it to that, Minor powers and Smite (docs/rules-flow.md §11.62, GitHub issue #8).

abilities.name: Daemon-Hunter
abilities.text: You are a Psyker; you begin play with the Rites of Banishment psychic power. You may purchase additional powers from the Sanctic discipline.

wargear.name: armoured copy of the liber daemonica

name: Grimnyr
note: SPECIES printed Kin only (not "Kin or Ironkin"). The suggested talents are Skeinwrought psychic powers. The Skeinwrought discipline is the Species' one Discipline of choice (Disciplines Known, Core p.257), so `onlyDisciplines` keeps it to that, Minor powers and Smite (docs/rules-flow.md §11.62, GitHub issue #8).

abilities.name: Conduit to the Ancestor Cores
abilities.text:
You are a Psyker; you know the Smite psychic power. You know one power from the Skeinwrought discipline and may learn other powers from the Skeinwrought discipline.

In addition, add +1 Resolve to allies with the LEAGUES OF VOTANN keyword within 6m.

name: Kâhl
note: Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Identify Weakness (RR1 p. 66).

abilities.name: Eye of the Ancestors
abilities.text:
As a Free Action at the start of each of your turns, you may spend 1 Glory to Judge a single enemy you can see. You may also Judge an enemy for free as a Reflexive Action if they kill a LEAGUES OF VOTANN ally. You may have a maximum number of enemies Judged equal to twice your Rank. Whenever a Judged enemy is slain or leaves the scene, they are no longer Judged, and you may choose to remove the Judged state from an enemy when you Judge a new enemy.

When a LEAGUES OF VOTANN ally makes an attack against a Judged enemy, for each Exalted Icon shifted for damage, add +2ED rather than +1ED.

name: Khorne Berzerker
note: No suggested attributes or skills printed.

abilities.name: Blood for the Blood God!
abilities.text:
When you make an All-Out Attack, you may add up to +Rank additional Wrath dice to your dice pool, in addition to the normal Wrath die. If any of these Wrath dice are 6s, then you score a Critical hit. That Critical Hit increases in effect as if a Glory point had been spent, for each Wrath die after the first which rolls a 6.

In addition, you gain 1d3x4 Corruption when you select this Archetype.

name: Logis
note: Suggested Talents lists the Divination powers Prescience, Psychometry and Scrier's Gaze (Core pp.274-275); they are in powerIds. "Availability N (Rarity)" is read as a Value of N or less and that Rarity or lower (the wargear filters).

abilities.name: Technoprophet
abilities.text: You may purchase psychic powers from the Divination discipline even though you are not a Psyker, and you know one power from that Discipline. Using these powers requires an Investigation test in place of a Psychic Mastery test, and you do not choose a power level. Use of these abilities is not considered a psychic power. A Complication that results from one of these abilities inflicts 1d3+1 Shock, due to logic errors and paradoxical outcomes.

name: Magos
note: The Canticles of the Omnissiah rule is the page's sidebar, which the Forge-Lord ability refers to. "Availability N (Rarity)" is read as a Value of N or less and that Rarity or lower (the wargear filters).

abilities.name: Forge-Lord
abilities.text: You halve the time it takes to attempt any Tech test, and you add +Double Rank bonus dice to interact with machinery. In addition, as a Simple Action you may invoke one of the Canticles of the Omnissiah (see sidebar).

abilities.name: Canticles of the Omnissiah
abilities.text:
These binaric blessings are as much programming as exhortations to action, and they take effect automatically.

Invoking a Canticle requires a DN 1 Tech test, adding +1 to the DN for each affected ADEPTUS MECHANICUS character after the first. Affected characters must be within 15m of the Magos or connected by Data-Tether.

All references to Rank in the Canticles below refer to the Rank of the Magos invoking the Canticle. A character may only benefit from one Canticle at a time, and the effects last only until the start of the Magos’ next turn.
- INCANTATION OF THE IRON SOUL: Affected characters add +Rank to their Resolve.
- LITANY OF THE ELECTROMANCER: Roll 1d6 for each enemy Engaged with an affected character; on a 6, that enemy suffers 1d3 Mortal Wounds.
- CHANT OF THE REMORSELESS FIST: Affected characters add +Rank bonus dice to melee attacks.
- SHROUDPSALM: Affected characters add +Rank to Defence.
- INVOCATION OF MACHINE MIGHT: Affected characters add +Rank to the damage value of their melee weapons.
- BENEDICTION OF THE OMNISSIAH: Affected characters add +Rank bonus dice to ranged attacks.
- ORISON OF SCRUTINY: Affected characters add +Rank bonus dice to Awareness Tests.
- TECHNOSUPPLICATION: Affected characters add +Rank bonus dice to Tech Tests.

name: Navis Scion
note: Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Fashionista (RR1 p.65). Tracks in the Stars and Void Watcher, listed as Suggested Talents, are Navigator powers, so they are in powerIds. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 176.

abilities.name: Elite Warp Guide
abilities.text:
You are trained to be able to guide a starship through the Warp. In addition, you are a PSYKER, and may only learn and use Navigator powers. You begin with the Lidless Stare power and one other Navigator power.

Finally, your status and influence are such that you gain +Rank bonus dice on Persuasion (Fel) Tests and Influence tests made to negotiate or to acquire goods and services.

name: Noise Marine
note: SKILLS prints "Persuade 2", read as Persuasion. No Suggested Attributes or Skills printed. Suggested talent printed as "Acute Sense [Hearing]".

abilities.name: Cacophony and Ecstasy
abilities.text:
You add +Double Rank bonus dice on Awareness and Insight tests that relate specifically to hearing, and you can pick out sounds, and variations in sounds that a normal human cannot. Further, you recover Rank Shock at the end of every turn, as you revel in the din of battle. However, if you reach Max Shock, you are Staggered as well as Exhausted, as you are overcome by sensation.

In addition, you gain 1d3x4 Corruption when you select this Archetype.

name: Oblivion Knight
note: Printed SPECIES: Pariah. Pariah is a Human template (Apocrypha p.12, option group `human-templates`), whose 30 XP "is already included in the cost of all Pariah archetypes". "Psyk-out Grenades" is printed without a count. The printed XP doesn't include the Pariah template's 30, though p.12 says Pariah archetypes include it. XP as printed plus the Pariah template's 30 XP, which p.12 says every Pariah archetype includes (GM ruling, docs/rules-flow.md §11.37).

abilities.name: Ex Oblivio
abilities.text: You add +Rank ED to all attacks you make against creatures with the PSYKER or DAEMON keyword. In addition, for the purposes of your Pariah species abilities, and any Pariah-specific talents you possess, your Willpower is increased by +Rank.

name: Plague Marine
note: The stat block is headed "NURGLE PLAGUE MARINE". No Suggested Attributes or Skills printed.

abilities.name: Disgustingly Resilient
abilities.text:
You may roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. In addition, any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored rather than being converted into Shock. However, your Speed is reduced by 1.

In addition, you gain 1d3x4 Corruption when you select this Archetype.

name: Primaris Aggressor
note: The ability name is printed "Firestorm.".

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.text: When you make a ranged attack and do not move during your turn, you increase the Salvo of your weapons by +Rank. In addition, when you wield a pair of Auto Boltstorm Gauntlets or Flamestorm Gauntlets, you may benefit from the Dual Wield or Simultaneous Strike talents even though those weapons lack the Pistol trait.

name: Primaris Hellblaster
note: Suggested talent printed "Duty Unto Death (p. 133)", resolved to Core's Duty Until Death.

abilities.name: Hellblaster Focus
abilities.text: When you make an attack with a PLASMA weapon, you may re-roll up to Double Rank dice.

mods.what: May re-roll up to Double Rank dice on attacks with this weapon (Apocrypha p.183).

name: Primaris Inceptor
note: Meteoric Descent is printed "You run, sprint, or charge…" (probably "When you…"). Guns Blazing is a bold second paragraph of the Archetype Ability.

abilities.name: Meteoric Descent
abilities.text: You run, sprint, or charge using your jump pack, any enemy within 2m of the point where you landed must pass an Agility test (DN 2+Rank) or be knocked prone and suffer a Mortal Wound.

abilities.name: Guns Blazing
abilities.text: When you wield a pair of Assault Bolters or Plasma Exterminators, you may benefit from the Dual Wield or Simultaneous Strike talents even though those weapons lack the Pistol trait.

name: Primaris Vanguard Infiltrator
note: Print error: the stat block is headed "PRIMARIS VANGUARD INCURSOR"; the page heading and the p.70 table name it Primaris Vanguard Infiltrator.

abilities.name: Voxbane
abilities.text: When you make a Tech interaction attack against an enemy, the range of the attack is multiplied by 1+Rank.

name: Primaris Chaplain
note: Space Marine Chaplain page (Tier 4/Tier 5): two stat blocks. The page adds: "Chaplains may purchase Litanies of Devotion, found later in this manuscript." This is the Primaris block. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 388. The page's Tier 4 Adeptus Astartes block (312) fits the pattern.

abilities.name: Spiritual Leader
abilities.text: You, and all allies with the IMPERIUM keyword within 15+Rank metres add +Rank to Resolve. This increases to +Double Rank if they share your [CHAPTER] keyword.

name: Primaris Librarian
note: Space Marine Librarian page (Tier 4/Tier 5): two stat blocks. Suggested Talents lists the Librarius powers Fury of the Ancients, Psychic Fortress and Psychic Scourge; they are in powerIds. This is the Primaris block. The Universal Psyker Abilities come with the PSYKER keyword (Core p.375); the "one other Psychic Discipline of your choice" is the Species' default choice (Disciplines Known, Core p.257), so it isn't granted here.

abilities.name: Psyker
abilities.text: You are a psyker; you have all the Universal psyker abilities, you know the Smite psychic power. You know the Librarius discipline, and receive one power from that Discipline, and you may select one other Psychic Discipline of your choice to learn powers from.

name: Primaris Techmarine
note: Space Marine Techmarine page: headed Tier 4 but prints a Tier 4 Adeptus Astartes block and a Tier 5 Primaris block. This is the Primaris block; its keywords don't include PRIMARIS. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 389. The page's Tier 4 Adeptus Astartes block (329) fits the pattern.

abilities.name: Hymn of Reforging
abilities.text: You receive +Double Rank to Tech tests to repair damaged machinery. All Tech tests you make take half the standard time.

name: Warpsmith
note: Print error: the stat block prints TIER 3; the page heading ("Warpsmith (Chaos, Tier 4)") and the p.72 table say Tier 4, which is used here. The printed 218 XP is ratings + 30, which also fits Tier 4 (Tier 3 would be 208).

abilities.name: Daemon-Smith
abilities.text:
You add +Rank to all Tech tests to control or repair daemonic or corrupted technology, or to corrupt Imperial technology. You only take half as long as normal to perform a Tech test.

In addition, you gain 1d3x4 Corruption when you select this Archetype.

name: Adamus Assassin
note: No INFLUENCE printed. Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Blademaster (RR1 p.61), which is not the Apocrypha Exarch Power of that name (blademaster-exarch).

abilities.name: Decapitation Strike
abilities.text: When you make a melee attack against a single enemy—not as part of a multi-attack or multi-action—you gain bonus dice on your attack equal to the number of Personal Ruin that enemy possesses. Further, each Exalted Icon rolled on that melee weapon’s ED inflicts one Mortal Wound.

name: Callidus Assassin
note: No INFLUENCE printed. ATTRIBUTES prints "Intelligence 3", read as Intellect. Wargear prints "Polymorphine (2 doses)". XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 318.

abilities.name: Betrayal's Blade
abilities.text: When disguised or otherwise concealing your identity, you gain a Stealth Score based on the total of your Deception test. This score only decreases when you take actions which may reveal your true intentions (GM’s discretion).

name: Culexus Assassin
note: Printed SPECIES: Pariah. Pariah is a Human template (Apocrypha p.12, option group `human-templates`), whose 30 XP "is already included in the cost of all Pariah archetypes". No INFLUENCE printed. ATTRIBUTES prints "Intelligence 3", read as Intellect. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 278. The extra 30 is the Pariah template's cost, which p.12 says is included.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.text: Enemies engaged with you at the end of their turn must pass a Willpower test (DN 2+Rank) or suffer Shock equal to your Rank. PSYKERs suffer Shock equal to twice your Rank instead.

name: Custodian Guard
note: Wargear adds: "Some Custodian Guard bear a Sentinel Blade and Storm Shield instead of their Guardian Spear." The ability's "IMPERIAL keyword" is as printed (probably IMPERIUM). No Suggested Talents printed.

abilities.name: Magisterium Lex Ultima
abilities.text: You answer only to the Emperor. You gain +Rank bonus dice whenever you make a social Skill Test against another character with the IMPERIUM keyword. In addition, allies with the IMPERIAL keyword add +Rank to their Resolve when within 10m of you.

name: Eversor Assassin
note: No INFLUENCE printed.

abilities.name: Hyper-Metabolism
abilities.text:
Each time you kill an enemy or inflict a Critical Hit, recover 1d3+Rank Shock immediately.

However, when you suffer one or more Wounds in melee, roll 1d6; on a 4+, the attacker suffers a Mortal Wound. If you are killed, you detonate, inflicting 10 +4ED damage with AP-2 to everything within Blast (X), where X is your Toughness.

wargear.name: Eversor combat drugs (3 doses of Fury, 3 doses of Destroyer, 1 dose of Terminus)

name: Harlequin Solitaire
note: Printed under an "Aeldari" heading, so factionId aeldari. No INFLUENCE printed. Pivotal Role is the page's sidebar. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 279.

abilities.name: The Path of Damnation
abilities.text: Other Aeldari shun you, and you add +6 to the DN of all Interaction tests with other Aeldari outside of ritual circumstances or performances. All Aeldari – even allies – must pass a Fear test (DN 3) when they first meet you. However, you automatically succeed at all Conviction and Resolve tests.

abilities.name: Blitz
abilities.text: At the start of one of your turns, you may choose to initiate a Blitz. When you do so, your Speed is doubled, and you ignore Double Rank DN increases on Multi-Attacks until the end of your turn. Once you have done this, you cannot do so again until after your next Regroup.

abilities.name: Pivotal Role
abilities.text:
Many senior Harlequins take on specific roles within a Troupe or a performance, that differ from the normal role of the Harlequin. When you select this Archetype, you may choose to replace Blitz with one of the following:

- SHOCKING EMERGENCE: As a Free Action at the start of combat, you may take on an indistinct, shimmering form, and cannot be seen or targeted by enemies or allies; you cannot take any actions other than movement in this form. At the start of any of your turns, you may reveal yourself, and you add +Rank bonus dice to any melee attack you make if you charge on the turn you reveal yourself.
- CHROMATIC RUSH: Your speed is increased by +Double Rank. This replaces the increase to Speed from the Harlequins’ Rising Crescendo ability.
- UNNATURAL ACROBATICS: Your Defence is increased by +Rank.

name: Vanus Assassin
note: No INFLUENCE printed. Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Identify Weakness (RR1 p.66), Rumoursmith (RR2 p.66).

abilities.name: Noospheric Interloper
abilities.text: You may attempt Tech Interaction Attacks at a range of your Intellect multiplied by your Rank, and you may measure this distance from any servo-skull under your control. Further, if you succeed, you may inflict 1d3 Mortal Wounds (+1 per Icon shifted) or select an automated or machine-mounted weapon (which must be visible to, and within your Intellect in metres of, the target) and make a ranged attack with it.

name: Venenum Assassin
note: Print error, copied as printed: KEYWORDS prints "TEMPLUM VANUS" (the Vanus Assassin's keyword; probably meant TEMPLUM VENENUM). The ability name "The Venem" is as printed. No INFLUENCE printed. Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Anatomical Scourge (RR1 p.60), Trapmaster (RR2 p.66).

abilities.name: The Venem
abilities.text: Whenever a creature suffers the Poisoned (X) condition from an attack or weapon from you, they will suffer 1d3+Rank Mortal Wounds at the start of each of their turns. In addition, you cannot ever be affected by the Poisoned condition, and you are immune to poisons, diseases, and radiation effects.

name: Vindicare Assassin
note: No INFLUENCE printed. Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Longshot (RR2 p.65).

abilities.name: Perfect Shot
abilities.text: When you aim with a ranged weapon, you double the listed Range of the weapon, and you add +Rank bonus dice to the subsequent ranged attack.

name: Wraithblade
note: Printed SPECIES: Ghost Warrior. Printed under an "Aeldari" heading, so factionId aeldari. No Suggested Talents printed. Wargear prints "A pair of Wraithswords, or a Wraithaxe and Force Shield." XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 398. The printed 358 is the ratings alone, without the Archetype Ability's 40.

abilities.name: Deathless Fury
abilities.text: You never suffer the DN increase for being Wounded, and you add +Rank bonus dice to all melee attacks when you have suffered more than half of your maximum Wounds.

name: Beast Snagga Boy

abilities.name: Monster Hunters
abilities.text: You add +Rank bonus dice to attacks made against enemy Monstrous Creature Threats and Vehicles.

note: "rarity Rare or better" is read as Rare or lower, as elsewhere in the book ("Rare or lower").

name: Bonesinger
note: The ability name is printed with a trailing colon ("Path of the Shaper:"). The Suggested Talents print Focus Will, Webway Step and Wraithtomb, which are psychic powers; they are in powerIds. The "one other discipline of your choice" is the Aeldari Species' default choice (Disciplines Known, Core p.257), so it isn't granted here.

abilities.name: Path of the Shaper
abilities.text: You are a psyker; you know the Smite and Vaul’s Song psychic powers and may purchase other powers from the Divination discipline, the Runes of Shaping discipline, and one other discipline of your choice.

abilities.name: Da Burny Dance
abilities.text: You add +1 to Resolve for every creature you can see which is currently On Fire. Each time you set a new creature On Fire, recover Rank +1 Shock.

abilities.name: Infovore
abilities.text: Whenever you succeed at an Investigation or Scholar test, and shift an Exalted Icon to gain additional information, you may ask a number of additional questions equal to your Rank. In addition, at the start of a scene, you may spend 1 Glory to ask the GM to give you a number of facts about the location or situation equal to your Rank.

name: Chirurgeon
note: Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Anatomical Scourge (RR1 p. 60), Angel of Mercy (RR1 p. 60). XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 117.

abilities.name: Morbid Expertise
abilities.text: When you attempt an Intimidation or Investigation Test to uncover information, you may add bonus dice equal to your Medicae skill ranks.

abilities.name: A Multitude of Weapons
abilities.text: You may use a Multi-Action to make attacks with multiple weapons at once, so long as those weapons are mounted on your Battlesuit. The DN increase for this Multi-Action is reduced by your Rank.

name: Demagogue
note: The entry's text also says: "Demagogues may purchase Prayers to the Dark Gods, found in Chapter III of this collection." Suggested talent printed "Supreme Presence [Persuasion]". XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 60. The printed XP equals the ratings alone, without the (Tier − 1) × 10.

abilities.name: Serpent’s Tongue
abilities.text: You add +Rank bonus dice to all Persuasion and Intimidation Interaction attacks against targets with the IMPERIUM, SCUM, or HERETIC keywords. On a successful Interaction Attack, you may spend 1 Wrath to add +Rank Exalted Icons to the result.

abilities.name: Pioneer
abilities.text: At the start of the first round of combat, before any turns have been taken, you may make a normal move (if on foot) or a normal Drive action (if on a Magna-Coil Bike).

name: Historitor-Investigatus
note: The Suggested Attributes, Skills and Talents are identical to the Magistrate's (p.117). "a rarity of Rare or better" is read as Rare or lower, as elsewhere in the book ("Rare or lower").

abilities.name: Intensive Research
abilities.text: Your studies are broad and deep, and your wealth of knowledge can serve you in all manner of ways. When you make a skill test, you may spend 1 Wrath to use your Scholar (Int) dice pool instead of the dice pool you would normally have used for that skill test.

name: Inquisitorial Storm Trooper
note: Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Bloodhound (RR1. P61), Identify Weakness (RR1, p.66).

abilities.name: Priority Target
abilities.text:
At the start of the first round of combat, before any actions are taken, select a single enemy you can see or who you know for certain is present in the scene. They are your priority target. Against your priority target, you may re-roll up to Rank dice on all Awareness tests and attacks.

Once your priority target has been slain, you may select a new priority target as a Simple Action.

name: Magistrate
note: The ability is printed without an "if": "Increase that to Double Rank bonus dice your target possess the SCUM keyword."

abilities.name: Cast Judgement
abilities.text: Add +Rank bonus dice when you make an Intimidation test—including an interaction attack—to coerce or subdue someone. Increase that to Double Rank bonus dice your target possess the SCUM keyword.

abilities.name: Fix it Proppa
abilities.text: You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on Tech tests to fix any weapon, vehicle, or other machine with the ORK keyword. In addition, during a regroup or respite, you may tinker with a weapon, vehicle, or other machine with the ORK keyword. If tinkering with a weapon, you may add your Rank from the weapon’s Range (add the same to all range categories), ED, Salvo rating, or any rated Trait the weapon already possesses. Other machines gain a bonus of the GM’s discretion. These bonuses last until the next respite, or until the machine suffers a complication, whichever comes first.

name: Navigator
note: The Suggested Talents print Tracks in the Stars and Void Watcher, which are Navigator powers; they are in powerIds. "Lidless Stare" resolved to The Lidless Stare. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 72.

abilities.name: Warp Guide
abilities.text: You are trained to be able to guide a starship through the Warp. In addition, you are a PSYKER, and may only learn and use Navigator powers. You begin with the Lidless Stare power.

name: Navy Breacher
note: The stat block is titled "IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER"; the heading is "Navy Breacher (Imperial Navy, Tier 2)".

abilities.name: Breach and Clear
abilities.text: When you take your turn, you may use a Simple Action to prepare for an ally within 6m of you. If you do so, you may Keep the Initiative to allow that ally to take a turn, without needing to spend Glory. This ability does not function if the chosen ally has already taken a turn, and it does not allow you to Keep the Initiative if you normally couldn’t. You may use this a number of times each scene equal to your Rank.

name: Navy Officer
note: The stat block is titled "IMPERIAL NAVY OFFICER"; the heading is "Navy Officer (Imperial Navy, Tier 2)". XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 50.

abilities.name: Voice of Authority
abilities.text: You gain +Rank bonus dice on all Leadership skill tests to command, bolster, or rally NAVIS IMPERIALIS characters, or to issue orders aboard a starship. Further, NAVIS IMPERIALIS characters within 6m of you may add your Rank bonus to their Resolve.

name: Novice-Sister
note: SPECIES is printed as "Pariah": a Human with the Pariah template (option group human-templates, p.12), whose 30 XP "is already included in the cost of all Pariah archetypes". "Bolter" resolved to Boltgun. XP as printed plus the Pariah template's 30 XP, which p.12 says every Pariah archetype includes (GM ruling, docs/rules-flow.md §11.37).

abilities.name: Proloquor
abilities.text: When you speak on behalf of your superior, you may add +Double Rank dice to your Leadership, Persuasion, or Influence tests.

name: Painboy
note: Print error copied as printed: "you may spend an Exalted Icon from to remove a single Traumatic Injury".

abilities.name: Make It All Betta
abilities.text: You add Double Rank bonus dice to all Medicae tests made on characters with the ORK keyword. In addition, when making a Medicae test on an ORK character outside of combat, you may spend an Exalted Icon from to remove a single Traumatic Injury immediately, as you crudely reattach lost body parts.

name: Reaver
note: Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Death From Above (RR1 p. 64). XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 78. The printed XP equals the ratings alone, without the (Tier − 1) × 10.

abilities.name: Lethal Swiftness
abilities.text:
While riding a Reaver Jetbike, you may attempt to roll Determination against damage inflicted to your vehicle: roll dice equal to your Pilot dice pool, or the Jetbike’s Handling score, whichever is higher. Each icon converts Wounds to Shock as normal.

In addition, you may add +Rank ED to the damage of your Reaver Jetbike’s Bladevanes.

name: Rogue Psyker
note: The stat block is titled "CULT WITCH"; the heading and the Chaos table (p.72) say Rogue Psyker. KEYWORDS also print "You may not select the KHORNE keyword." (in requires). The Suggested Talents print Dark Flame, Soul Shrivel and Touch of Corruption (Core p.281), which are psychic powers; they are in powerIds. "Battle-Psyker (RR1, p. 61)" is battle-psyker-rr1, not IoE's Aeldari Battle Psyker. The Universal Psyker Abilities come with the PSYKER keyword (Core p.375); the "one other Psychic Discipline of your choice" is the Species' default choice (Disciplines Known, Core p.257), so it isn't granted here.

abilities.name: Witchcraft
abilities.text:
You are a psyker; you have all the Universal psyker abilities, you know the Smite psychic power. You know the Maleficarum discipline, and receive one power from that Discipline, and you may select one other Psychic Discipline of your choice to learn powers from.

Further, when you use a psychic power, you may re-roll up to Tier dice on your Psychic Mastery test, but each dice you re-roll counts as an additional Wrath Complication.

In addition, you gain 1d3x2 Corruption when you select this Archetype.

abilities.name: Slaver
abilities.text: You are accompanied by a mob of Grots (p. 358) equal to your Rank x4. If any of your Grots die, they can be replaced between sessions at the GM’s discretion. All Grots, Snotlings, and Squigs within 10 + Rank metres of you add your Leadership to their Resolve.

name: Seeker

abilities.name: Tenacious Hunter
abilities.text: Whenever you make an Awareness (Int) test to detect a hidden enemy, you may add +Rank bonus dice to your test. During combat, at the start of your turn, you may suffer 1 Shock to add +Rank to your Passive Awareness until the start of your next turn.

note: XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 62.

abilities.name: Outcast Penitent
abilities.text: You add +Rank bonus dice to Corruption tests, any Test to resist the effects of a psychic power, and Determination rolls.

abilities.name: Irradiated and Augmented
abilities.text: You do not bleed (making you immune to Bleeding), and gain +Rank bonus dice to Determination rolls. In addition, any living creature without the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS keyword within 2 metres of you at the start of their turn must pass a DN 3 Toughness Test or suffer the Poisoned condition. This poison is radiation poisoning, inflicting 1 Mortal Wound and Rank Shock at the start of each of the Poisoned character’s turns.

abilities.name: False Guise
abilities.text:
You possess numerous cover identities. You can create up to Rank alternative identities, which function in the same way as with the Secret Identity talent. You may only use one identity at a time, and if one is revealed or exposed, you may replace it with a new identity. These identities have their own Influence score, with a bonus starting at +0.

When you use one of your identities, you may re-roll up to double Rank bonus dice on Deception tests.

name: Speed Freek
note: Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Bullet Hell (printed "RR1 p. 132"; it is on RR1 p.62).

abilities.name: Fasta! FASTA!
abilities.text: When you are the PILOT or CREW of an ORK vehicle, you do not replace extra dice with Wrath dice when travelling at Break-Neck Speed. Further, you add +2 to your Conviction and Resolve while mounted on an ORK vehicle. This increases to +3 on any turn in which you travel at Breakneck Speed.

abilities.name: Behind Enemy Lines
abilities.text: When you attempt a Stealth test while operating a Stealth Battlesuit, you may reduce your Stealth dice pool by Rank. For each die removed, you score 1 Icon on the test.

abilities.name: Tank Hunter
abilities.text: When you make an attack against a vehicle, you may reroll up to Double Rank dice.

name: Transmechanic
note: "Augur array (auspex)" resolved to the Core Auger Array.

abilities.name: Vox Communion
abilities.text: You can silently communicate with any vox or similar communications device within Rank x100 kilometres. You may also make Awareness (Int) or Investigation (Int) tests to detect concealed signals and study intercepted signals. You add +Rank bonus dice to any Investigation (Int) or Scholar (Int) test to decipher a code, translate a language, or create a new cipher.

abilities.name: Incite Zeal
abilities.text: You add +Double Rank to all Persuasion Interaction attacks against targets with the IMPERIUM, SCUM, or HERETIC keywords. In addition, you may spend a Wrath point to make yourself Frenzied; If you do so, then you may make all allies with the IMPERIUM keyword within 15 +Double Rank metres Frenzied as well.

name: Assault Space Marine
note: No Suggested Attributes or Skills are printed. The ability is printed without "within": "all enemies 2 metres of the point where you land". "Aquila Power Armour" resolved to the Core Aquila Mk VII. "Astartes Chainsword" links to VoA's Chainsword (p.62, Astartes Melee Weapons).

abilities.name: Hammer of Wrath
abilities.text: When you charge into melee using your jump pack, all enemies 2 metres of the point where you land must pass an Agility test (DN 2 +Rank) or be knocked Prone.

name: Brôkhyr Iron-Master
note: The Suggested Talents end with a placeholder, printed "##". The keyword is printed BRÔKHYR; the keyword schema only allows A–Z, so it is written BROKHYR.

abilities.name: Guild Techniques
abilities.text: You receive +Rank on Tech tests to repair a damaged LEAGUES OF VOTANN machine, or to craft a new one. You may re-roll up to Rank dice on any skill test made to use a device you’ve personally built. You are considered to have built all of your starting wargear personally.

name: Cadre Fireblade
note: Suggested skill printed as "Intimidate 2"; read as Intimidation.

abilities.name: Volley Fire
abilities.text: When an ally within 12m of you makes a ranged attack with a PULSE weapon, their weapon increases its Salvo rating by +Rank.

name: Air Caste Messenger

abilities.name: At Home in the Skies
abilities.text: When you attempt a difficult manoeuvre in an aircraft or spacecraft, reduce the DN of the action by Rank.

note: XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 18.

name: Back-Alley Doc

abilities.name: Improvised Healing
abilities.text: You may make Medicae tests without the use of a medikit, relying on numerous improvised techniques. In addition, when you heal an ally’s Wounds, they also recover 1d3+Rank Shock.

note: Stimm printed as "3 uses of Stimm".

name: Beastman Auxiliary

abilities.name: Bestial Zealotry
abilities.text: When you can see an enemy (either an obvious foe, or a creature identified as an enemy by an ally or superior), you add +Rank to your Resolve, and add +Rank bonus dice to any melee attacks you make when you charge.

note: Keyword printed "MILITARUM AUXILIA"; mapped to Core's MILITARUM AUXILLA.

abilities.name: The Enemy Within
abilities.text:
While disguised, you gain +Rank bonus dice on all Deception tests to pass as an Imperial citizen. When no longer disguised, you gain +Rank bonus dice on all Interaction Attacks against IMPERIAL characters.

In addition, you gain 1d3 Corruption.

name: Earth Caste Technician

abilities.name: State of the Art
abilities.text: When you attempt to repair T’AU technology or attempt to operate a complex piece of T’AU technology using a Tech test, you may re-roll a number of dice equal to twice your Rank.

note: The wargear list ends in a trailing comma as printed. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 24.

abilities.name: Freeze!
abilities.text: At the start of the first round of combat, before anyone has taken a turn, you may make an Intimidate Interaction Attack against a single enemy who can see and hear you.

name: Frateris Militia

abilities.name: Fervour
abilities.text: When within hearing range of a character with the ADEPTUS MINISTORUM keyword, you increase your Resolve by +Rank. In addition, if that Adeptus Ministorum character has suffered any wounds during the current scene, your Determination is increased by +Rank while you remain within 10 metres of them.

wargear.name: Symbol of devotion (tin aquila, devotional scroll, etc.)

note: SKILLS prints "Ballistic Skill 1 or Weapon Skill 1": the skill-choice grant; `skills` is empty. The 6 XP is Willpower 2 plus one of them. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 4.

name: Fire Caste Breacher

abilities.name: Urban Clearance Tactics
abilities.text: You have an efficient way of flushing enemies out of defensive positions. When you make a ranged attack against an enemy who has taken the Blinded or Pinned conditions, add +Rank ED to the attack’s damage.

note: No ATTRIBUTES line is printed.

name: Fire Caste Pathfinder

abilities.name: Vanguard
abilities.text: You’re practised at staying mobile while unnoticed, avoiding attention until necessary. While you have a Stealth score, increase your Speed by +Rank. Further, at the start of the first round of combat, before turn order is determined, you may make a normal move.

note: No ATTRIBUTES line is printed.

name: Fire Caste Warrior

abilities.name: Disciplined Volley
abilities.text: You are used to laying down consistent, deadly volleys of fire. When you make a ranged attack with a PULSE weapon, and did not move during your turn, you may increase the weapon’s Salvo rating by +Rank.

note: No ATTRIBUTES line is printed.

name: Hearthkyn Warrior

abilities.name: Stalwart Comrade
abilities.text: When you make an attack against an enemy who has already been attacked this round, you gain +Rank bonus dice.

note: No SUGGESTED TALENTS printed.

name: Imperial Guard Medic

abilities.name: Field Medic
abilities.text: When you make a Medicae test during combat on a Dying character, add +Double Rank bonus dice.

note: Suggested talent printed "Take Cover" (Apocrypha's Take Cover!).

name: Imperial Guard Officer

abilities.name: Voice of Command
abilities.text: As a Combat Action, you may issue an order to allies with the [REGIMENT] keyword who are able to hear you. Issuing orders requires a DN 1 Leadership test to order a single ally, adding +2 DN for each additional ally. Orders can be found on the sidebar below.

abilities.name: Astra Militarum Officer Orders
abilities.text:
All references to Rank in the orders below refer to the Rank of the character giving the order. A character may only benefit from one order at a time, and an order’s effects last only until the start of the officer’s next turn.

Each Officer knows two of the Orders listed below at each Rank.

TAKE AIM! The ally may re-roll Double Rank dice on their next aimed ranged attack.

FIVE ROUNDS RAPID! On the ally’s next ranged attack with a LAS weapon with the Rapid Fire (X) Trait, increase the weapon’s Salvo and Rapid Fire (X) Traits by +Double Rank.

BRING IT DOWN! The officer chooses a single enemy, and the ally adds +Rank ED to their next ranged attack against that target.

FORWARDS, FOR THE EMPEROR! The ally may shoot as part of a Sprint action as if their weapon had the Assault trait.

REGROUP! The ally may Fall Back as a Simple Action, rather than a Combat Action.

MOVE! MOVE! MOVE! The ally adds +Rank to their Speed if they Run or Sprint in their next turn.

FIX BAYONETS! The ally adds +Rank bonus dice to their next melee attack.

note: The Orders sidebar on the same page is kept as a Rule.

name: Khorngor

abilities.name: The Scent of Blood
abilities.text: You become Frenzied when an enemy is killed within 10 metres of you. While Frenzied, you add +Rank ED to all melee attacks you make. In addition, gain +1d3 Corruption

note: Shares p.88 with Pestigor.

name: Pestigor

abilities.name: Inured to Suffering
abilities.text: You add +Rank to both your Resolve and your Determination. In addition, gain +1d3 Corruption

note: Shares p.88 with Khorngor.

name: Penal Legionnaire

abilities.name: Death Sentence
abilities.text: Your life is forfeit anyway, so what is there left to fear? When you fail a Resolve Test, you may choose to suffer 1d3 Shock immediately to count as having passed that Resolve Test instead.

note: The p.70 table calls it "Penal Trooper". No ATTRIBUTES line is printed. Keyword printed "MILITARUM AUXILIA"; mapped to Core's MILITARUM AUXILLA. Wargear prints "1d3+1 knifes" (a random count, qty "1d3+1") and "3 doses of Frenzon with injector".

name: Sister Dialogus Polyglot

abilities.name: Sanctified Linguist
abilities.text: You add +Rank bonus dice on Scholar tests relating to language, and you know Double Rank additional languages. You also gain +Rank Conviction.

note: Its own archetype, not FSPG's Sister Dialogus (the p.70 table doesn't mark it red as having an official version). Wargear prints "copy of the Rule of the Sororitas".

name: Sister Famulous

abilities.name: Spiritual Advisor
abilities.text: You add +Rank bonus dice to Leadership and Persuasion tests when interacting with the Nobility of the Imperium. You also add +Rank to your Conviction.

note: "copy of Rule of the Sororitas".

name: Slaangor

abilities.name: Distracting Musk
abilities.text: Characters within 5 metres of you which lack the SLAANESH keyword add +Rank to the DN of all Intelligence and Willpower tests. In addition, gain +1d3 Corruption

note: Shares p.93 with Tzaangor.

name: Tzaangor

abilities.name: Aura of Change
abilities.text: Your Resilience increases by +Rank, and you make roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. In addition, gain +1d3 Corruption.

note: "you make roll Determination" as printed. Shares p.93 with Slaangor.

name: Water Caste Functionary

abilities.name: Careful Words
abilities.text: When you attempt an Interaction Attack using Persuasion, you receive +Double Rank bonus dice. When resisting Persuasion-based Interaction Attacks, increase your Resolve by +Rank.

note: No SUGGESTED TALENTS printed. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 28.

name: Wrack

abilities.name: Insensible to Pain
abilities.text: Your maximum Shock is increased by +Rank. Further, when you roll Determination, you may re-roll any die which rolls a 1. You may roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. You cannot wear armour, due to your altered physiology.

note: Print error: the SUGGESTED ATTRIBUTES ratings are blank (XP Cost 18), and the suggested skills, talents and XP match the Wych's on p.97. XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 58.

name: Wyrd

abilities.name: Self-Taught Witchcraft
abilities.text:
You are a psyker; you know a number of randomly determined Minor Psychic Powers equal to 1 +Rank, and you may learn additional Minor Powers. Each time you suffer Perils of the Warp, you lose the power you attempted to use, and must randomly generate a new minor power to replace it.

You may not learn Smite or powers from any psychic discipline unless you have ascended and achieved Tier 2 or higher.

note: Print error: the stat block is titled "BACK-ALLEY DOC" (copied from p.74); the name here is the entry heading. Suggested skill printed "Intimidate 1". "one dose of Spook".

abilities.name: Aerial Hunter
abilities.text: While you are PILOT of an AERONAUTICA IMPERIALIS vehicle, the vehicle’s Defence is increased by +Rank while it is moving. In addition, you may re-roll up to Rank dice on attacks using the weapons of any AERONAUTICA IMPERIALIS vehicle you are PILOT or CREW of.

abilities.name: Inviolate Jurisdiction
abilities.text: While wielding a shield, you may take the Full Defence action as a Simple Action, rather than a Full-Round Action, and you may add +1 die to the Initiative Test for each ally wielding a Shield within Rank metres.

abilities.name: Ruthless Efficiency
abilities.text: When you make a ranged attack at short range with a Shotgun of any kind, for each Exalted Icon you shift for additional damage, you add +2ED rather than +1ED.

name: Astropath

abilities.name: Soul-bound Psyker
abilities.text:
You are a Psyker; you know the Telepathy psychic power and may purchase additional psychic powers from the Telepathy Discipline. If you purchase an access to an additional Discipline, it must be Divination or Theosophamy.

You permanently have the Blinded condition, though you can perceive the world well enough as long as you can use your psychic powers. You add +Rank to your Conviction, and you may spend ten minutes entering a trance in order to use the Telepathy psychic power with a range of 1 Light Year rather than 100m. Each use of Telepathy over this distance may only communicate with other Astropaths, and it inflicts 1d3 Shock.

note: The suggested psychic powers (Mind Probe, Psychic Shriek, Psychometry, Scrier's Gaze, Core pp.275–279) are printed under SUGGESTED TALENTS. The additional Discipline is the Species' default choice (Disciplines Known, Core p.257); `onlyDisciplines` keeps it to Divination or Theosophamy, beside Telepathy and the Minor powers and Smite every Psyker may learn (Core p.257).

name: Banisher

abilities.name: Litany of Purity
abilities.text: You have +1 Faith Point. When you attempt an Intimidation or Persuasion Interaction Attack against a DAEMON, you may spend one Faith point to invoke the Litany of Purity. If the Interaction Attack succeeds, the DAEMON is Pinned in addition to other effects, and suffers 1d3 Mortal Wounds, +1 per Exalted Icon shifted.

note: Suggested talents printed in Redacted Records, now linked: Disarming Stare (RR1 p.64), Forbidden Knowledge (RR1 p.65). XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 80.

name: Black Sentinel

abilities.name: Witch-Guard
abilities.text: You are trained to react swiftly to psychic phenomena. When a PSYKER within Double Rank metres of you attempts to use a Psychic Power, or suffers Perils of the Warp, you may use your Reflexive action to immediately attack that Psyker. If the attack inflicts one or more Wounds, the psychic power and any accompanying Perils of the Warp immediately fails. If you use this ability on a friendly Psyker, you may choose to reduce the damage inflicted by up to Rank.

note: XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 90. The printed XP equals the ratings alone, without the (Tier − 1) × 10.
